latency_ms.method: server time.monotonic() when the source handed the frame over, to client time.monotonic() after the JPEG decoded; one host's monotonic clock, so loopback only

latency_wall_ms.method: the same two moments on time.time(): across hosts it carries the clocks' offset (M4's clock_sync)

camera_stream.method: frames decoded by the client's thread; dropped = sequence numbers never decoded (conflate keeps the newest, so a slow reader skips frames by design); bytes as received

loop_dt_ms.method: V1 motion.py: time between successive reads of the arm, ms

policy_stats.method: time.perf_counter around preprocess + predict_action_chunk + postprocess, with the device synchronised before and after; the first call after loading (the warm-up) is reported apart
